This evokes digital video, without default analog VHS tracking bars, tape damage or film scratches, and requires neither people nor a domestic setting.

styles.image_style_prompt_zh: 笔触厚涂式三维风格化渲染，清楚且有重量的三维大形，略夸张的平面转折与软硬交替边缘；可见宽笔触和层叠色块沿形体走向，材质差异由画出的高光、边缘和色温表现；暖主光与冷色阴影建立大块明暗，焦点处细、背景概括，保留绘画痕迹而非全表面写实纹理。保留用户指定的主体、内容与必要文字，仅改变视觉表现；未出现或未要求的题材元素不补入。
styles.image_style_prompt_en: Painterly 3D rendering with weighty readable volumes, slightly exaggerated plane breaks and a deliberate mix of hard and soft edges. Visible broad brush marks and layered color patches follow the forms; material identity comes from painted highlights, edge treatment and color temperature. Warm key light against cool colored shadows, clear value masses, refined focal detail and broadly painted backgrounds; preserve brushwork instead of photoreal surface noise. Preserve the user's specified subjects, content and required text; change visual treatment only and do not invent unrequested scene elements.
avoid: 笔触纹理在物体表面滑动
styles.video_motion: 相机缓慢平移，已有可动主体完成一次克制小动作，静物保持稳定；笔触像固定于物体表面的绘制，减少纹理游移，不自动加入人物或道具。
video_consistency: 笔触尺度与方向随表面结构稳定
固定暖光冷影关系与主要色块
保持三维体积，不逐帧塌成平面插画
各镜头统一边缘软硬与细节密度
